comparison.objective: Set and lock a luggage pull handle at a marked length, versus iteratively tune a damper setting to physical stop behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Unlock, translate, and re-engage a spring pin; the candidate additionally requires fine tool insertion, bounded torque, collar rotation, moving-socket reacquisition, and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Handle remains at the marked working length with the pin engaged and hands withdrawn; the record lacks a retention-load test and has no dynamic-response limits.
comparison.reason: Although both adjust and lock a mechanism, the luggage task verifies a discrete position lock rather than closed-loop energy-absorption commissioning.
